evaluation.caveat: Agent-labeled exploratory sample, deliberately stratified by initial-model agreement/disagreement. Labels fixed before viewing the hybrid output, not sent to the reviewer. Not a representative production accuracy estimate.

notes: HTTP 400 from an unsupported minimum constraint; removed from API schema and retained in local validation. No usage returned, so its cost remains unknown.
Default-effort review reached 32,000 output tokens and failed before producing a usable answer. Reported usage cost $0.0250742. Low effort subsequently succeeded.

findings: Hybrid improved the exploratory audit from 16/26 to 20/26, fixing four scored errors and regressing none in this sample; Claude alone scored 22/26.
The successful review produced five corrections affecting 48 headlines, while preserving all 1,087 article assignments exactly once.
Review corrected the 11-article mixed packaging event, separated unrelated DOJ/FDA/cyber-watchdog items from cyber-director coverage, and reunited Texas-execution coverage.
Review missed the Burchett-to-Boebert label error, the Palisades split, and Myanmar verdict/reaction splits. It returned empty places for its rewritten groups, so location coverage decreased.

The successful hybrid configuration cost $0.0623809 and took 428.120 seconds, compared with Claude alone $0.1378994 / 764.969 seconds. Setup failures are recorded separately and excluded from these reusable configuration totals.

Recommendation: useful lower-cost improvement over Luna alone, but it did not beat Claude alone in this sample; keep experiment results separate from production until broader owner-reviewed evaluation.
